name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Auto-Firing Turret
effect: The weapon is mounted to an immovable stand that turns and aims automatically using artificial intelligence that locks onto targets. The turret must remain connected to the terminal via wiring. Before activating the turret, you can designate any number of creatures who will not be targeted by the turret. You can spend 6 AP to activate or deactivate the turret from its terminal. When you roll combat sequence, roll combat sequence for the turret. The turret's bonus to combat sequence is equal to your Intelligence ability modifier. On each of the turrets turns it gains 10 AP which it uses to attack the closest creature in the weapon's short range. It does not spend its AP to do anything else. The turret is considered a robot with 25 hit points and an AC of 10. If the turret falls to 0 hit points, it ceases function and the weapon gains 1 level of decay.
equippableWeapons: Any weapon.
craftMaterials: x1 circuitry, x4 gears, x2 glass, x3 oil, x8 screws. x6 steel or x12 wood.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Bayonet
effect: Attach a knife or combat knife to the front of the weapon, you can attack with the knife without spending AP to switch weapons.
equippableWeapons: Any ranged weapon with the Two Handed property.
craftMaterials: x1 knife with no levels of decay, x3 adhesive and x3 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Boosted Capacitor
timeToEquip: 60 - (5 x your Intelligence score) in minutes.
effect: Enhanced power consumption of the primary energy chassis. When you attack with a weapon that has this modification, you can spend 2 rounds of ammunition instead of 1 to increase the damage by 2.
equippableWeapons: Any energy weapon. A weapon cannot have a boosted capacitor if it has an overclocked capacitor.
craftMaterials: x3 adhesive, x6 circuitry, x5 crystal, x4 nuclear material, x4 screws, x2 gold, x6 steel.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Double Action
effect: A revolver trigger mechanism upgrade fires the round and cocks the hammer simultaneously. When you spend AP to attack with the weapon, it costs 1 less to a minimum of 1.
equippableWeapons: Any revolver.
craftMaterials: x5 of each material required to craft the type of ranged weapon you are modifying, x3 adhesive and x3 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Ergonomic Grip
effect: An overall improvement to the weapon's grip, handling, and design to allow easier and more comfortable use. The weapon's critical hit damage modifier or damage dice increases by 1.
equippableWeapons: Any weapon.
craftMaterials: x3 of each material required to craft the type of ranged weapon you are modifying, x3 adhesive, x3 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Hardened Receiver
timeToEquip: 60 - (5 x your Intelligence score) in minutes.
effect: An improvement to the firing mechanism to increase the power of the projectile. The weapon gains Destructive and Powerful. If the weapon already has Destructive, then the weapon's damage dice rank increases once to a maximum of d12. The weapon's load increases by 2.
equippableWeapons: Any handgun, submachine gun, rifle, or shotgun. A weapon cannot have a hardened receiver if it has a Light Build.
craftMaterials: x5 of each material required to craft the type of ranged weapon you are modifying, x4 adhesive, x4 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Holographic weapon sight
timeToEquip: 5 - (your Intelligence score) in minutes. Minimum of 1 minute.
effect: A holographic reticle that is projected onto a non-magnifying sight. The weapon's attack roll total is increased by 1. The weapon's load increases by 1.
equippableWeapons: Any ranged weapon. A weapon cannot have a Holographic weapon sight if it already has a Scope or Infrared Scope.
craftMaterials: x2 adhesive, x2 fiber optics, x2 fiberglass, x2 glass, x1 nuclear material, x2 screws, x1 gold.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Improved Rifling
timeToEquip: 60 - (5 x your Intelligence score) in minutes.
effect: An upgrade to the grooves in the barrel of a firearm. The weapon's range modifiers are increased by half.
equippableWeapons: Any handgun, submachine gun, or rifle except for the Flare Gun, H&H Tools nail gun, or Railway Rifle.
craftMaterials: x2 steel.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Increased Clip Size
effect: A longer and larger clip that feeds into the magazine to allow more rounds to be fired. The weapon's number of rounds is increased by 3.
equippableWeapons: Any handgun, submachine gun, rifle, or shotgun that does not have Manual Reload or Quick Reload.
craftMaterials: x2 steel, x6 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Infrared Scope
effect: A highly technological pre-war wonder that uses thermal imaging to locate targets. The weapon's long range modifier is tripled. However, any attacks made at targets within 30 feet are made at disadvantage. You can target creatures that are hidden, shrouded, in complete darkness, or invisible so long as they are not behind full cover. Additionally, the weapons attack rolls are increased by 2. The weapon's load increases by 2.
equippableWeapons: Any revolver or rifle including the Laser Rifle, Plasma Rifle, or Gauss Rifle. A weapon cannot have an Infrared Scope if it already has a Scope or Holographic weapon sight.
craftMaterials: x2 adhesive, x2 fiber optics, x2 fiberglass, x2 glass, x6 nuclear material, x2 screws, x1 gold.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Laser Sight
timeToEquip: 5 - (your Intelligence score) in minutes. Minimum of 1 minute.
effect: A device that projects a beam onto targets, providing a visual reference point. The weapon gains Accurate. If it already has Accurate, then whenever the weapon critically hits; the damage is doubled. The weapon's load increases by 1.
equippableWeapons: Any handgun, rifle, or energy weapon except for the Tri-Beam Laser Rifle, Multiplas Rifle, or Gatling Laser.
craftMaterials: x2 adhesive, x2 fiber optics, x2 glass, x2 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Light Build
timeToEquip: 60 - (5 x your Intelligence score) in minutes.
effect: Replacing parts of the weapon with lighter materials for rebalance and ease of operation. The weapon's load decreases by half. The weapon's Strength requirement decreases by 1. The weapon gains Breakable.
equippableWeapons: Any weapon. A weapon cannot have a Light Build if it is Strengthened.
craftMaterials: None.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Longer Barrel
effect: An increase on the length of the barrel to provide more range at the cost of poorer short range. The weapon's long range modifier increases by 10. The weapon's short range modifier decreases by 2. The weapon's load increases by 4.
equippableWeapons: Any handgun, rifle, or energy weapon.
craftMaterials: x3 steel.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Lucky Charm
effect: A little attachment that personalized your weapon. The weapon's critical hit chance decreases by 1. Each player character can only benefit from one lucky charm. (The charm can be moved to other weapons, but you cannot have two charms on two different weapons.)
equippableWeapons: Any weapon.
craftDC: +2 and Luck ability score must be 7 or higher.
craftMaterials: x1 of any material, x1 of any material, x1 of any material.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Muzzle Brake
effect: A device that is fitted to the muzzle of a firearm to redirect propellant gasses outwards to reduce both recoil and muzzle rise. The weapon's attack roll total is increased by 1. The weapon's Strength requirement decreases by 1. The weapon's load increases by 2.
equippableWeapons: Any handgun, submachine gun, rifle, or shotgun except for the Flare Gun, H&H Tools nail gun, or Railway Rifle.
craftMaterials: x3 adhesive, x4 aluminum.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: On-Board Target Tracking
effect: A gyroscopic muzzle synchronized with the weapons sights and utilizing an artificial intelligence that locks onto targets and significantly improves aim. Before you make an attack with a weapon that has this modification, you can spend 6 AP to mark a target creature within the weapon's short range. Attack rolls against the marked creature have advantage.
equippableWeapons: Any energy weapon except for the Gauss rifle, Gauss pistol, or Gatling Gun.
craftMaterials: x7 adhesive, x9 aluminum, x4 circuitry, x6 crystal, x5 fiber optics, x4 nuclear material, x5 screws, x4 gold.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Overclocked Capacitor
timeToEquip: 60 - (5 x your Intelligence score) in minutes.
effect: Even further improvements to the weapons power consumption. When you attack with a weapon that has this modification, you can spend 3 rounds of ammunition instead of 1 to increase the damage by 4.
equippableWeapons: Any energy weapon that doesn't have automatic or charge. A weapon cannot have an overclocked capacitor if it has a boosted capacitor.
craftMaterials: x8 adhesive, x8 circuitry, x6 crystal, x12 fiberglass, x6 gold, x6 nuclear material, x3 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Remote Controlled Turret
effect: The weapon is mounted to an immovable stand that turns and aims based on your input from a nearby terminal. The turret must remain connected to the terminal via wiring. You can spend 6 AP to activate or deactivate the turret from its terminal. You can spend AP to attack with a weapon that you place onto the mount. The amount of AP required to attack is reduced by 2 to a minimum of 3. If your Intelligence ability score is less than the weapons Strength requirement, you have disadvantage on attack rolls while operating the weapon in this way. The turret is considered a robot with 25 hit points and an AC of 10. If the turret falls to 0 hit points, it ceases function and the weapon gains 1 level of decay.
equippableWeapons: Any weapon.
craftMaterials: x1 terminal. x3 circuitry, x8 gears, x2 glass, x6 oil, x12 screws. x10 steel or x18 wood.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Scope
effect: A simple glass scope that allows for distant magnification, for weapons that already have a scope; this modification increases the magnification. The weapon's short range modifier is doubled and the long range modifier is quadrupled. However, any attacks made at targets within 50 feet are made at disadvantage. The weapon's load increases by 2.
equippableWeapons: Any revolver or rifle. The Laser Rifle, Plasma Rifle, or Gauss Rifle. A weapon cannot have a Scope if it already has an Infrared Scope or Holographic weapon sight.
craftMaterials: x2 adhesive, x4 glass, x2 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Semi-Automatic
timeToEquip: 60 - (5 x your Intelligence score) in minutes.
effect: An overhaul of the weapon's firing mechanism to allow rounds to be much more quickly loaded into its chamber. The weapon gains Semi-Automatic.
equippableWeapons: Any weapon that doesn't have Manual Reload, Quick Reload, Automatic, Area of Effect, or Energy Weapon.
craftMaterials: x5 of each material required to craft the type of ranged weapon you are modifying, x3 adhesive and x3 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Silencer
effect: A muzzle device that reduces the acoustic intensity of the muzzle report. While you are hidden; any attack rolls you make with a weapon that has a silencer modification does not reveal your presence to nearby creatures, allowing you to remain hidden except against the creature you attacked. The weapon's load increases by 2. The weapon's damage dice rank decreases once to a minimum of d4.
equippableWeapons: Any handgun, submachine gun, rifle, or shotgun except for the Flare Gun, H&H Tools nail gun, or Railway Rifle.
craftMaterials: x4 adhesive, x4 aluminum, x4 plastic, x3 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Speedloader
effect: A device used for loading multiple chambers of a revolver simultaneously. You can choose to reload the weapon with 4 AP.
equippableWeapons: Any revolver.
craftMaterials: x6 aluminum, x2 screws.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Stock
effect: Added back portion that provides structural support, for weapons that already have a stock; this modification improves them. The weapon's attack roll total is increased by 1. The weapon's load increases by 4.
equippableWeapons: Any submachine gun, rifle, shotgun, energy weapon, or revolver with the long barrel modification.
craftMaterials: x4 adhesive, x6 wood.

name: Ranged Weapon Mod: Strengthen
timeToEquip: 60 - (5 x your Intelligence score) in minutes.
effect: Reinforcing the weapon's structure and improving its weaker mechanisms and flaws. The weapon gains Sturdy and Defensive. The weapon's load increases by 2.
equippableWeapons: Any weapon. A weapon cannot be Strengthened if it has a Light Build.
craftMaterials: x3 of each material required to craft the type of ranged weapon you are modifying, x3 adhesive and x3 screws.

name: Melee Weapon Mod: Strengthen
effect: The weapon gains Durable. This modification is permanent and cannot be switched.
equippableWeapons: All melee weapons; whether or not a weapon can use the mods is up to your GM.
craftMaterials: x3 of each material required to craft the type of melee weapon you are modifying, x3 adhesive or x3 screws.

name: Melee Weapon Mod: Double Sided
effect: The weapon gains Defensive and Two Handed. Its load is doubled and its Strength requirement increases by 1.
equippableWeapons: All melee weapons; whether or not a weapon can use the mods is up to your GM.
craftMaterials: x1 copy of the weapon that has no levels of decay, x3 adhesive and x3 screws.

name: Melee Weapon Mod: Heavy
effect: The weapon's AP increases by 1 to a maximum of 6, its load increases by half, and its Strength requirement increases by 1. The weapon gains Weighted. The weapon's critical hit modifier or damage dice increases by 1. This modification is permanent and cannot be switched.
equippableWeapons: All melee weapons; whether or not a weapon can use the mods is up to your GM.
craftMaterials: x3 of each material required to craft the type of melee weapon you are modifying, x5 adhesive and x5 screws.

name: Melee Weapon Mod: Upgraded
effect: Whenever you deal damage with the weapon and roll a 1 or a 2 on the damage dice, the damage is increased by 2. This modification is permanent and cannot be switched.
equippableWeapons: All melee weapons; whether or not a weapon can use the mods is up to your GM.
craftMaterials: x5 of each material required to craft the type of melee weapon you are modifying, x3 adhesive and x3 screws.

name: Melee Weapon Mod: Light Build
effect: The weapon's AP decreases by 1 to a minimum of 3, its load decreases by half, and its Strength requirement decreases by 1. The weapon gains Breakable. This modification is permanent and cannot be switched.
equippableWeapons: All melee weapons; whether or not a weapon can use the mods is up to your GM.
craftMaterials: None.

name: Melee Weapon Mod: Sharpened, Serrated, or Barbed
effect: The weapon gains Mangle.
equippableWeapons: All melee weapons; whether or not a weapon can use the mods is up to your GM.
craftMaterials: None.

name: Melee Weapon Mod: Ergonomic
effect: The weapon's critical chance decreases by 1.
equippableWeapons: All melee weapons; whether or not a weapon can use the mods is up to your GM.
craftMaterials: x5 of each material required to craft the type of melee weapon you are modifying, x5 adhesive or x5 screws.
